description: Skycastle CLI->MCP steering for Grok: PreToolUse on run_terminal_command detects skycastle secrets/export and redirects to MCP secret tools when daemon up. Fails open.

hooks.command: PLUGIN_ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || [ ! -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skycastle-enforce.sh" ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'; exit 0; fi; sh "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skycastle-enforce.sh"
